title: Electrode Cleaning Solution Preparation
author: Michael Economo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8pwhvpe

steps.title: Prepare 1.2X cleaning solution
steps.instruction: Measure 116.67 mL deionized H₂O in a beaker, add 0.117 g NaCl, add 10 mL of 10 % SDS, add 50 mL of 0.2 M Tris buffer (pH 8.5), and mix to obtain a 1.2X cleaning solution (total ≈167.67 mL).

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL 0.2 M Tris buffer, pH 8.5.
Mix until homogeneous; final volume ≈167.67 mL.

steps.title: Prepare 1X cleaning solution
steps.instruction: On the day of use, add 2 mL 10X trypsin to 10 mL of the 1.2X cleaning solution and mix to produce 12 mL of 1X cleaning solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL 10X trypsin to 10 mL 1.2X cleaning solution.
Mix gently to obtain 12 mL of 1X cleaning solution.
